previous_audits.chain_closure_explanation: L1–T3 close mathematically under the declared finite tensor-product, supplied bond-Hamiltonian, and Heisenberg-evolution hypotheses. The accepted axioms do not supply those hypotheses or the transfer-H/quasilocal-composition bridge, so the framework-level chain remains open.
previous_audits.claim_scope: For a finite tensor-product qubit algebra with a supplied nearest-neighbor Hermitian bond Hamiltonian and supplied Heisenberg evolution, L1–T3 and the exact three-site reaching/stalling exhibits hold with the region-level constant c=2JM; no volume-uniform or physical propagation claim is included.
previous_audits.load_bearing_step: supp(ad_H^k A) is contained in N^k(supp A), so every Taylor coefficient of [A_X(t),B_Y] with k<d(X,Y) vanishes.
previous_audits.notes_for_re_audit_if_any: missing_bridge_theorem: derive and retain a bridge supplying the global tensor-product carrier, reconstructed many-body transfer Hamiltonian, Heisenberg evolution, and matching finite/quasilocal tail composition, then re-audit.
previous_audits.verdict_rationale: Independent support-induction, Taylor-series, commutator-norm, and factorial-tail checks confirm L1–T3, and the exact Pauli algebra confirms the reaching and stalling exhibits. The verdict remains conditional because the tensor-product carrier, bond Hamiltonian, and Heisenberg evolution are supplied beyond the accepted axioms, while the physical transfer-H/quasilocal-composition bridge remains open. N1/N4/N7 close five distinct attacks directly, use no prior negative as proof, and resolve the hostile steelman by restricting the result to the named exhibit. N2/N3/N5/N6/N8 show the declared conditions remain independent, expose no hidden load-bearing premise, keep the rhetoric at the tested resolution, find no primitive or partial closure that supplies the physical bridge, and find no cross-cycle echo retiring that residual.
